title.zh: 卷十八 本紀第十八: 哀宗下
title.raw: 卷十八 本紀第十八: 哀宗下 Volume 18 Annals 18: Aizong 2

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅朔，詔減親衛軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuyin new moon: an edict reduced the personal guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuyin new moon: an edict cut the personal guard.

sentences.zh: 己丑，軍士殺鄭門守者出奔。

translations.literal: On jichou soldiers killed the Zheng Gate guards and fled outward.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou soldiers killed the guards at Zheng Gate and fled the city.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，起上党公張開及臨淄郡王王義深、廣平郡王范成進為元帥。

translations.literal: On renchen Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai and the princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were recalled and made marshals.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zhang Kai, Duke of Shangdang, and Princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were recalled and made marshals.

sentences.zh: 以前御史大夫完顏合周權參知政事。

translations.literal: Former Censor-in-Chief Wanyan Hezhou was named acting participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Former censor-in-chief Wanyan Hezhou was named acting participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以榜召民賣放下年軍需錢，上戶田租如之。

translations.literal: On wei an edict by placard called the people to sell and remit next year's military-supply tax; wealthy households' land rent likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On wei a placard called the people to sell grain and pay next year's military-supply levy; wealthy households' land rent was levied the same way.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，夜大雷，工部尚書蒲乃速震死。

translations.literal: On xinchou at night came a great thunderclap; Minister of Works Punaisu was struck dead.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, at night, thunder rolled; Minister of Works Punaisu was killed by the bolt.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申朔，遣使以鐵券一、虎符六、大信牌十、織金龍文禦衣一、越王玉魚帶一、弓矢二賜兗王用安，其父母妻皆贈封之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, wushen new moon: envoys were sent with one iron tally, six tiger tallies, ten great trust plaques, one dragon-pattern imperial robe brocaded in gold, one Yue-king jade fish belt, and two bow-and-arrow sets to bestow on Prince of Yan Yong'an; his parents and wife were all given honorary titles.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wushen new moon: envoys bore one iron tally, six tiger tallies, ten great trust plaques, a gold-brocaded dragon robe, a Yue-king jade fish belt, and two sets of bow and arrows for Prince of Yan Yong'an; his parents and wife received posthumous or honorary enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 又以世襲宣命十、郡王宣命十、玉免鶻帶十付用安，其同盟可賜者即賜之。

translations.literal: Also ten hereditary imperial mandates, ten prince mandates, and ten jade gyrfalcon belts were given to Yong'an; eligible allies among his confederates received gifts at once.
translations.idiomatic: Ten hereditary mandates, ten prince mandates, and ten jade gyrfalcon belts went to Yong'an as well; allies who qualified received their share immediately.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣張開、溫撒辛、劉益、高顯率步軍護陳留、通許糧道。

translations.literal: On xinhai Zhang Kai, Wensaxin, Liu Yi, and Gao Xian were sent to lead foot soldiers guarding the grain route through Chenliu and Tongxu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhang Kai, Wensaxin, Liu Yi, and Gao Xian led foot troops to guard the Chenliu–Tongxu grain route.

sentences.zh: 罷貧民進獻糧。

translations.literal: The requirement for poor households to present tribute grain was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Poor households were no longer required to present tribute grain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，招鄉導。

translations.literal: On wuwu country guides were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court recruited local guides.

sentences.zh: 己未，有箭射入宮中，書奸臣姓名，兩日而再得之。

translations.literal: On jiwei an arrow was shot into the palace bearing the names of traitorous ministers; the same thing happened again two days later.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an arrow flew into the palace inscribed with the names of traitorous ministers; two days later it happened again.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，再括京城粟，以御史大夫合周、點檢徒單百家等主之。

translations.literal: On xinyou grain in the capital was seized again, under Censor-in-Chief Hezhou, Inspector Tushan Baijia, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the capital's grain was seized again under censor-in-chief Hezhou, inspector Tushan Baijia, and others.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，括粟使者兵馬都總領完顏九住以粟有蓬稗，杖殺孝婦於省門。

translations.literal: On bingyin Wanyan Jiuzhu, grain-seizure envoy and commander-in-chief of horse and foot, because the grain held chaff and weeds had a filial widow beaten to death at the provincial gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wanyan Jiuzhu, envoy for grain seizure and commander-in-chief of horse and foot, found chaff in the grain and had a filial widow beaten to death at the provincial gate.

sentences.zh: 十月，以前司農卿李渙飛語，詔左丞李蹊、戶部侍郎楊綎系獄，將以軍儲失計坐罪。

translations.literal: Tenth month: on former Minister of Agriculture Li Huan's slander, an edict put Left Vice Director Li Xi and Vice Minister of Revenue Yang Shao in prison, to punish them for failure in military-store planning.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: on former minister of agriculture Li Huan's whispered charges, an edict imprisoned left vice director Li Xi and vice minister of revenue Yang Shao for failure in military-store planning.

sentences.zh: 俄蹊、綎並除名，而止籍綎家貲。

translations.literal: Soon Xi and Shao were both struck from the rolls; only Shao's household goods were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Xi and Shao were both struck from the rolls; only Shao's household goods were inventoried.

sentences.zh: 渙遂權戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Huan then acted as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Huan was then named acting minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 尋赦殘欠糧，其應以糧事系者皆釋之。

translations.literal: Soon outstanding grain debts were forgiven; all held on grain-related charges were released.
translations.idiomatic: Soon unpaid grain debts were forgiven and everyone held on grain charges was released.

sentences.zh: 詔征諸道軍，期以十二月一日入援。

translations.literal: An edict called up armies from all circuits, with a deadline of the first day of the twelfth month to enter and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned armies from every circuit to enter relief by the first day of the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未朔，賜貧民粥。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei new moon: congee was given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingwei new moon: the poor were given congee.

sentences.zh: 平章政事侯摯致仕。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Hou Zhi retired.
translations.idiomatic: Chief councillor Hou Zhi retired from office.

sentences.zh: 左司郎中斜卯愛實以言事忤近侍，送有司，尋釋之。

translations.literal: Left Secretariat Director Xieyao Aishi offended close attendants by speaking on affairs; he was handed to the law offices and soon released.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyao Aishi of the Left Secretariat offended close attendants by speaking bluntly; the law offices took him, then released him.

sentences.zh: 己酉，衛州軍校白晝取豐備倉米。

translations.literal: On jiyou Weizhou military clerks seized grain from the Fengbei granary in broad daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Weizhou military clerks looted the Fengbei granary in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬子，京城人相食。

translations.literal: On renzi people in the capital ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the people of the capital ate one another.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔曹門、宋門放士民出就食。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict opened Cao Gate and Song Gate to let scholars and commoners out to find food.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict opened Cao Gate and Song Gate so scholars and commoners could leave the city to find food.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召諸將相入議事。

translations.literal: On renxu the generals and chief ministers were summoned to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the throne summoned generals and chief ministers to council.

sentences.zh: 兗王用安率兵至徐州，元帥王德全閉城不納。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Yong'an led troops to Xuzhou; Marshal Wang Dequan shut the gates and would not admit them.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yan Yong'an marched to Xuzhou; marshal Wang Dequan barred the gates and would not let him in.

sentences.zh: 會劉安國與宿帥眾僧奴引兵入援，至臨渙，用安使人劫殺之，攻徐州久不能下，退保漣水。

translations.literal: When Liu Anguo and Suzhou Commander Zhong Sengnu led relief troops to Linhuan, Yong'an had them ambushed and killed; the attack on Xuzhou dragged on without success, and he withdrew to hold Lianshui.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Anguo and Suzhou commander Zhong Sengnu were bringing relief to Linhuan when Yong'an had them ambushed and killed; he besieged Xuzhou for a long time without taking it and fell back to Lianshui.

sentences.zh: 制使因世英以用安不赴援，還至宿州西，遇大元兵，死之。

translations.literal: Commissioner Yin Shiying, because Yong'an would not march to relief, was returning west of Suzhou when he met Great Yuan troops and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Yin Shiying, since Yong'an would not come to relief, was returning west of Suzhou when he met Great Yuan troops and died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河、解元帥權興寶軍節度使趙偉襲據陝州以叛，殺行省阿不罕奴十剌以下凡二十一人，誣阿不罕奴十剌等反狀以聞。

translations.literal: On bingyin Zhao Wei, marshal of He and Jie circuits and acting military commissioner of Xingbao Army, seized Shaanzhou in revolt, killing twenty-one men of the traveling secretariat including Abuhanu Shila, and reported a false charge of rebellion against them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhao Wei, marshal of He and Jie and acting commissioner of Xingbao Army, seized Shaanzhou in revolt, killed twenty-one men of the traveling secretariat down to Abuhanu Shila, and reported them as rebels.

sentences.zh: 上知其冤，不能直其事，就授偉元帥左監軍，兼西安軍節度使，行總帥府事。

translations.literal: The emperor knew they were innocent but could not set the matter right; Zhao Wei was at once made left marshal-inspector, concurrent Xi'an military commissioner, and acting headquarters commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew they were wronged but could not right the deed; he confirmed Zhao Wei as left marshal-inspector, Xi'an military commissioner, and acting headquarters commander.

sentences.zh: 偉尋亦歸北。

translations.literal: Wei soon went over to the north as well.
translations.idiomatic: Wei soon defected north as well.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子朔，以事勢危急，遣近侍即白華問計，華對以紀季以酅入齊之義，遂以為右司郎中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingzi new moon: with the situation critical, a close attendant was sent to consult Bai Hua on the spot; Hua answered with the precedent of Ji Ji entering Qi with Xi, and was thereupon made Right Secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingzi new moon: with affairs desperate, a close attendant sought Bai Hua's counsel on the spot; Hua cited Ji Ji bringing Xi into Qi, and was made Right Secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔議親出。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict ordered discussion of the emperor going out in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict ordered the court to debate the emperor's going out in person.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，再議於大慶殿，上欲以官奴、高顯、劉益為元帥，不果。

translations.literal: On yiyou debate was held again in Daqing Hall; the emperor wished to make Guannu, Gao Xian, and Liu Yi marshals, but it did not happen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court debated again in Daqing Hall; the emperor wanted Guannu, Gao Xian, and Liu Yi as marshals, but the plan failed.

sentences.zh: 是日，除拜扈從及守京城官。

translations.literal: That day appointments were made for those who would escort him and for officials defending the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day the throne named those who would escort the emperor and those who would hold the capital.

sentences.zh: 以右丞相、樞密使兼左副元帥賽不，平章政事、權樞密使兼右副元帥白撒，右副元帥兼樞密副使權參知政事訛出，兵部書權尚書左丞李蹊，元帥左監軍行總帥府事徒單百家等率諸軍扈從。

translations.literal: Saibu, right chief councillor and privy councilor and concurrent left vice marshal; Ba Sa, chief councillor and acting privy councilor and concurrent right vice marshal; Echu, right vice marshal and privy vice commissioner and acting participation councillor; Li Xi, acting minister of war and acting left vice director of the Masters of Writing; Tushan Baijia, left marshal-inspector acting headquarters commander, and others led the armies in escort.
translations.idiomatic: Saibu, right chief councillor, privy councilor, and left vice marshal; Ba Sa, chief councillor, acting privy councilor, and right vice marshal; Echu, right vice marshal, privy vice commissioner, and acting participation councillor; Li Xi, acting minister of war and acting left vice director; Tushan Baijia, left marshal-inspector and acting headquarters commander, and others led the escort.

sentences.zh: 參知政事兼樞密院副使完顏奴申，樞密副使兼知開封府權參知政事習捏阿不，裏城四面都總領、戶部尚書完顏珠顆，外城東面元帥把撒合，南面元帥朮甲咬住，西面元帥崔立，北面元帥孛朮魯買奴等留守。

translations.literal: Wanyan Nushen, participation councillor and privy vice commissioner; Cinie Abu, privy vice commissioner and acting prefect of Kaifeng and acting participation councillor; Wanyan Zhuke, commander of all four sides of the inner city and minister of revenue; Basahao, eastern outer-city marshal; Zhujia Yaozhu, southern marshal; Cui Li, western marshal; Bolulü Mainu, northern marshal, and others remained to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Nushen, participation councillor and privy vice commissioner; Cinie Abu, privy vice commissioner, acting Kaifeng prefect, and acting participation councillor; Wanyan Zhuke, commander of the inner city on all four sides and minister of revenue; Basahao, eastern outer marshal; Zhujia Yaozhu, south; Cui Li, west; Bolulü Mainu, north—they and others held the capital.

sentences.zh: 除拜既定，以京城付之。

translations.literal: Once appointments were settled, the capital was entrusted to them.
translations.idiomatic: When the appointments were fixed, the capital was placed in their hands.

sentences.zh: 擢魏璠翰林修撰，如鄧州招武仙入援。

translations.literal: Wei Fan was promoted to Hanlin academician and sent to Dengzhou to summon Wu Xian to relief.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Fan was raised to Hanlin academician and sent to Dengzhou to summon Wu Xian to the relief army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上禦端門，發府庫及兩府器皿宮人衣物賜將士。

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor appeared at Duan Gate and distributed treasury stores, the two palaces' vessels, and palace women's clothing to the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor stood at Duan Gate and gave out the treasury, vessels from both palaces, and palace women's garments to the troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，官奴、阿裏合謀立荊王不果，朝廷知其謀，置不問。

translations.literal: On wuxu Guannu and Ali plotted to install the Prince of Jing and failed; the court knew of the plot and let it pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Guannu and Ali plotted to set up the Prince of Jing and failed; the court knew and let the matter drop.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上發南京，與太后、皇后、諸妃別，太慟。

translations.literal: On gengzi the emperor set out from Nanjing, parting from the empress dowager, empress, and consorts in great grief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor left Nanjing, taking leave of the empress dowager, empress, and consorts in bitter grief.

sentences.zh: 行次公主苑，太后遣中官持米肉遍犒軍士。

translations.literal: On the march, at Princess Garden the empress dowager sent eunuchs with rice and meat to reward the troops throughout.
translations.idiomatic: At Princess Garden on the march the empress dowager sent eunuchs with rice and meat to feast the troops along the line.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，至開陽門外，麾百官退。

translations.literal: On xinchou he reached outside Kaiyang Gate and waved the hundred officials back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he came to outside Kaiyang Gate and dismissed the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 詔諭戍兵曰：「社稷宗廟在此，汝等壯士也，毋以不預進發之數，便謂無功，若保守無虞，將來功賞顧豈在戰士下？

translations.literal: An edict addressed the garrison troops: "The altars of state and the ancestral temple are here. You are stalwart men. Do not think that because you are not counted among those marching out you will have no merit. If you hold firm without mishap, future rewards will surely not rank below the warriors'."
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the garrison: "State and ancestral temple rest here. You are stalwart men. Do not suppose that because you are not in the marching host you will lack merit. Hold the city without fault, and your rewards hereafter will not rank below the warriors'."

sentences.zh: 」聞者皆灑泣。

translations.literal: " All who heard wept.
translations.idiomatic: " All who heard wept.

sentences.zh: 是日，鞏昌元帥完顏忽斜虎至自金昌，為上言京西三百里之間無井灶，不可往，東行之議遂決，以為尚書右丞從行，遂次陳留。

translations.literal: That day Gongchang Marshal Wanyan Huxiehu arrived from Jinchang and told the emperor that for three hundred li west of the capital there were no wells or hearths and the route was impossible; the plan to go east was adopted, he was made right vice director and marched with the emperor, and they halted at Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: That day Gongchang marshal Wanyan Huxiehu came from Jinchang and told the emperor that for three hundred li west of the capital there were neither wells nor hearths and the road was impossible; the court chose the eastern route, made him right vice director to march with the emperor, and halted at Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，次杞縣。

translations.literal: On renyin they halted at Qi County.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin they camped at Qi County.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，次黃城。

translations.literal: On guimao they halted at Huangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao they camped at Huangcheng.

sentences.zh: 丞相完顏賽不之子按春有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Grand Chancellor Wanyan Saibu's son An Chun was guilty and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Wanyan Saibu's son An Chun was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，次黃陵堈。

translations.literal: On jiachen the emperor halted at Huangling Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the court halted at Huangling Embankment.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諸將請幸河朔，從之。

translations.literal: On yisi the generals asked that he tour Hebei north of the river; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the generals asked to move the court to Hebei north of the river; he agreed.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙午朔，濟河，北風大作，後軍不克濟。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, bingwu new moon: crossed the river; a north wind rose violently and the rearguard could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the first month's bingwu new moon, the army crossed the river; a fierce north wind blew and the rearguard could not ford.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大元兵追擊于南岸，元帥完顏豬兒、賀都喜死之，建威都尉完顏兀論出降。

translations.literal: On dingwei Great Yuan troops pursued on the south bank; Marshals Wanyan Zhuer and Heduxi were killed; Jianwei Commandant Wanyan Wulunchu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Great Yuan forces pursued on the south bank; marshals Wanyan Zhuer and Heduxi were killed and Jianwei commandant Wanyan Wulunchu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上哭祭戰死士于河北岸，皆贈官，斬兀論出二弟以殉。

translations.literal: On jiyou the emperor wept and sacrificed to the dead soldiers on the north bank of the river; all were posthumously ennobled; Wulunchu's two younger brothers were beheaded as blood companions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the emperor wept and offered sacrifice to the dead on the north bank; all were posthumously ennobled, and Wulunchu's two younger brothers were beheaded to accompany them.

sentences.zh: 赦河朔，招集兵糧，議取衛州。

translations.literal: Amnesty for Hebei north of the river; troops and grain were summoned; taking Weizhou was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei north of the river was granted amnesty; troops and grain were mustered; the court debated taking Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 元帥蒲察官奴將忠孝軍千人，東面元帥高顯、果毅都尉粘哥咬住領軍萬人為前鋒，至蒲城。

translations.literal: Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial Army men; Eastern Marshal Gao Xian and Fruit-Steadfast Commandant Niange Yaozhu led ten thousand as vanguard, reaching Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial troops; eastern marshal Gao Xian and fruit-steadfast commandant Niange Yaozhu took ten thousand as vanguard to Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上次漚麻岡，平章政事白撒、元帥和速嘉兀底不繼至。

translations.literal: On gengxu the emperor halted at Oumagang; Equal Rank Bai Sa and Marshal Hesujia Wudibu followed up.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court halted at Oumagang; equal-rank minister Bai Sa and marshal Hesujia Wudibu came up afterward.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，白撒引兵攻衛州，不克。

translations.literal: On xinhai Bai Sa led troops to attack Weizhou but did not take it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Bai Sa attacked Weizhou but failed to capture it.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，聞大元兵自河南渡河，至衛之西南，遂退師，丁巳，戰于白公廟，白撒敗績，棄軍東遁。

translations.literal: On yimao, hearing Great Yuan troops had crossed from Henan and reached southwest of Wei, the army withdrew; on dingsi they fought at Baigong Temple; Bai Sa was defeated and abandoned the army fleeing east.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, learning Great Yuan forces had crossed from Henan to southwest of Wei, the army pulled back; on dingsi they fought at Baigong Temple, Bai Sa was routed, and he cast off the army and fled east.

sentences.zh: 元帥劉益、上党公張開亦遁，並為民家所殺。

translations.literal: Marshals Liu Yi and Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai also fled and were both killed by common households.
translations.idiomatic: Marshals Liu Yi and Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai also fled and were both killed by civilians.

sentences.zh: 益部曲王全降。

translations.literal: Yi's follower Wang Quan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's retainer Wang Quan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上進次蒲城，複還魏樓村。

translations.literal: On wuwu the emperor advanced to Pucheng, then returned to Weilou Village.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the emperor moved on to Pucheng, then fell back to Weilou Village.

sentences.zh: 李辛自汴京出奔，伏誅。

translations.literal: Li Xin fled from Bianjing and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xin fled Bianjing and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己未，上以白撒謀，夜棄六軍渡河，與副元帥、合裏合六七人走歸德。

translations.literal: On jiwei, on Bai Sa's counsel, the emperor by night abandoned the six armies and crossed the river; with the vice marshal, Helihe, and six or seven others he fled to Guide.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, following Bai Sa's plan, the emperor abandoned the six armies at night and crossed the river with the vice marshal Helihe and six or seven companions, fleeing to Guide.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諸軍始知上已往，遂潰。

translations.literal: On gengshen the armies only then learned the emperor had gone and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the armies only then learned the emperor had left and broke apart.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，司農大卿蒲察世達、元帥完顏忽土出歸德西門，奉迎上入歸德。

translations.literal: On xinyou Grand Agriculture Minister Pucha Shida and Marshal Wanyan Houtu left Guide's west gate to welcome the emperor into Guide.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou grand agriculture minister Pucha Shida and marshal Wanyan Houtu went out Guide's west gate to welcome the emperor into the city.

sentences.zh: 赦在府囚。

translations.literal: Amnesty for prisoners in the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners held in the prefecture were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 軍民普覃一官，賜進士終場王輔以下十六人出身。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians all advanced one rank; sixteen men from final-session jinshi Wang Fu downward were granted examination status.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians were each promoted one rank; sixteen men from Wang Fu, who had passed the final jinshi session, down were granted examination standing.

sentences.zh: 遣奉禦朮甲塔失不、後弟徒單四喜往汴京奉迎兩宮。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Zhujia Tashibu and the empress's brother Tushan Sixi were sent to Bianjing to escort the two palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant Zhujia Tashibu and the empress's brother Tushan Sixi were dispatched to Bianjing to bring back the two palaces.

sentences.zh: 白撒還自蒲城，聚兵於大橋，不敢入。

translations.literal: Bai Sa returned from Pucheng, gathered troops at Great Bridge, and dared not enter.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Sa came back from Pucheng, massed troops at Great Bridge, and did not dare enter the city.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣使召白撒至，數其罪，下之獄，仍籍其家財賜將士，曰：「汝輩宜竭忠力，毋如斯人誤國。

translations.literal: On renxu envoys were sent to summon Bai Sa; his crimes were enumerated, he was imprisoned, and his household wealth was still registered and given to the troops, with the words: "You should all exhaust loyalty and strength; do not be like this man who ruined the state.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu envoys summoned Bai Sa, recited his crimes, and threw him in prison; his property was seized for the troops with the message, "Serve with all your loyalty—do not be like this man who wrecked the state.

sentences.zh: 」人予金一兩。

translations.literal: " Each man was given one liang of gold.
translations.idiomatic: " Each soldier received one liang of gold.

sentences.zh: 七日，白撒及其子忽土鄰皆死獄中。

translations.literal: Seven days later Bai Sa and his son Hutulin all died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Seven days later Bai Sa and his son Hutulin died in prison.

sentences.zh: 右丞相賽不致仕。

translations.literal: Right Grand Councillor Saibu resigned from office.
translations.idiomatic: Right grand councillor Saibu retired.

sentences.zh: 右丞完顏忽斜虎行省事於徐州。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Wanyan Huxiehu exercised traveling Secretariat affairs at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice director Wanyan Huxiehu ran traveling Secretariat affairs at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 官奴再請率兵北渡，女魯懽不可。

translations.literal: Guannu again asked to lead troops north across the river; Nülühuan refused.
translations.idiomatic: Guannu again asked to cross north with an army; Nülühuan would not allow it.

sentences.zh: 遣歸德知府行戶部尚書蒲察世達、都轉運使張俊民如陳、蔡取糧，以元帥李琦、王璧護之。

translations.literal: Guide Prefect Acting Minister of Revenue Pucha Shida and Transport Commissioner Zhang Junmin were sent to Chen and Cai for grain, with Marshals Li Qi and Wang Bi to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: Guide prefect and acting minister of revenue Pucha Shida and transport commissioner Zhang Junmin were sent to Chen and Cai for grain, escorted by marshals Li Qi and Wang Bi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，安平都尉、京城西面元帥崔立與其党韓鐸、藥安國等舉兵為亂，殺參知政事完顏奴申、樞密副使完顏斜撚阿不，勒兵入見太后，傳令召衛王子從恪為梁王，監國。

translations.literal: On wuchen Pacification Commandant of Anping and Capital Western Marshal Cui Li with his clique Han Duo, Yao Anguo, and others raised troops in revolt, killed Participation Councillor Wanyan Nushen and Privy Vice Marshal Wanyan Xienian Abu, forced troops in to see the empress dowager, and transmitted an order summoning Prince of Wei Congke as Prince of Liang to oversee the state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Anping pacification commandant and capital western marshal Cui Li, with Han Duo, Yao Anguo, and their faction, mutinied, killed participation councillor Wanyan Nushen and privy vice marshal Wanyan Xienian Abu, marched in to see the empress dowager, and ordered Prince of Wei Congke installed as Prince of Liang to oversee the realm.

sentences.zh: 即自為太師、軍馬都元帥、尚書令，尋自稱左丞相、都元帥、尚書令、鄭王。

translations.literal: He immediately made himself Grand Preceptor, Army-and-Horse Chief Marshal, and Minister-in-Chief; soon he styled himself Left Grand Councillor, Chief Marshal, Minister-in-Chief, and Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: He at once took grand preceptor, army-and-horse chief marshal, and minister-in-chief; soon he called himself left grand councillor, chief marshal, minister-in-chief, and Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 弟倚平章政事，侃殿前都點檢，其党孛朮魯哥御史中丞，韓鐸副元帥兼知開封府，折希顏、藥安國、張軍奴、完顏合答並元帥，師肅左右司郎中，賈良兵部郎中兼右司都事，又署工部尚書溫蒂罕二十、吏部侍郎劉仲周並為參知政事，宣徽使奧屯舜卿為尚書左丞，戶部侍郎張正倫為尚書右丞，左右司都事張節為左右司郎中，尚書省掾元好問為左右司員外郎，都轉運知事王天祺、懷州同知康瑭並為左右司都事。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yi was Participation Councillor; Kan was Palace Front Commandant; his clique member Bolüluoge was Censor-in-Chief; Han Duo was Vice Marshal and concurrent Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda were all marshals; Shi Su was a Left and Right Department director; Jia Liang was Bureau of Military Affairs director and concurrent Right Department chief; he also appointed Minister of Works Wendihan Ershi and Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Zhongzhou as participation councillors; Palace Intendant Aotun Shunqing as Left Vice Minister, Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Zhenglun as Right Vice Minister; Department chief Zhang Jie as director; archival clerk Yuan Haowen as deputy director; and transport officials Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang as department chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Yi became participation councillor; Kan became palace front commandant; Bolüluoge, his partisan, censor-in-chief; Han Duo vice marshal and Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda marshals; Shi Su a department director; Jia Liang military affairs director and right department chief; Wendihan Ershi minister of works and Liu Zhongzhou vice minister of personnel participation councillors; Aotun Shunqing left vice minister; Zhang Zhenglun right vice minister; Zhang Jie department director; Yuan Haowen, a ministry clerk, deputy director; Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang department chiefs.

sentences.zh: 開封判官李禹翼棄官去。

translations.literal: Kaifeng judge Li Yuyi abandoned his post and left.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng judge Li Yuyi quit his office and fled.

sentences.zh: 戶部主事鄭著召不起。

translations.literal: Revenue clerk Zheng Zhao could not be summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue clerk Zheng Zhao refused summons.

sentences.zh: 是日，右副點檢溫敦阿裏，左右懷員外郎聶天驥，御史大夫裴滿阿虎帶，諫議大夫、左右司郎中烏古孫奴申，左副點檢完顏阿散，奉禦忙哥，講議蒲察琦並死之。

translations.literal: That day Right Deputy Commandant Wendun Ali, Left and Right Palace Gentlemen Attendant Yuanlang Nie Tianji, Censor-in-Chief Peiman Ahudai, Remonstrance Official and Department Director Wugulun Nushen, Left Deputy Commandant Wanyan Asan, Palace Attendant Mangge, and Lecturer Pucha Qi were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: That day right deputy commandant Wendun Ali, palace gentlemen Nie Tianji, censor-in-chief Peiman Ahudai, remonstrance official and department director Wugulun Nushen, left deputy commandant Wanyan Asan, palace attendant Mangge, and lecturer Pucha Qi were all slain.

sentences.zh: 遂送款大元軍前。

translations.literal: They then sent submission to the Great Yuan army.
translations.idiomatic: They then surrendered to the Great Yuan army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大元將碎不泬進兵汴京。

translations.literal: On guiyou Great Yuan General Suibuke advanced on Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Great Yuan general Suibuke marched on Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立閱隨駕官屬軍民子女於省署，及禁民間嫁娶，括京城財。

translations.literal: On jiaxu children of officials and troops who had followed the court were registered at the ministry, private weddings in the capital were forbidden, and the city's wealth was seized.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu dependents of the traveling officials and army were enrolled at the ministry, commoners' weddings in the capital were banned, and city wealth was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 兩宮值變不 果行，答失不以其父咬住、四喜以其妻奪門而出，庚午至歸德。

translations.literal: The two palaces could not travel because of the crisis; Tashibu broke out with his father Yaozhu and Sixi with his wife; on gengwu they reached Guide.
translations.idiomatic: The two palaces never set out because of the upheaval; Tashibu forced the gate out with his father Yaozhu and Sixi with his wife; on gengwu they arrived at Guide.

sentences.zh: 上怒二人，皆斬於市。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry at the two men and had them both executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious with both men and had them beheaded in public.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣右宣徽提點近侍局事移剌粘古如徐州，相地形，察倉庫虛實。

translations.literal: On yihai Right Palace Intendant Yila Niangu was sent to Xuzhou to survey the terrain and inspect granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai right palace intendant Yila Niangu was sent to Xuzhou to reconnoiter the ground and check storehouses.

sentences.zh: 白華如鄧州召兵。

translations.literal: Bai Hua went to Deng Prefecture to summon troops.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Hua went to Deng Prefecture to raise troops.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子朔。

translations.literal: Second month, bingzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on the bingzi new moon.

sentences.zh: 魚山張曁獻殺元帥完顏忽土，行省忽斜虎自率兵討之，會從宜嚴祿誅曁獻，乃還。

translations.literal: Yushan Zhang Xian offered to kill Marshal Wanyan Houtu; traveling secretariat Huxiehu led troops to suppress him; Acting Prefect Yanlu executed Xian and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xian of Yushan volunteered to kill marshal Wanyan Houtu; Huxiehu led traveling secretariat troops against him; acting prefect Yanlu executed Xian and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 括城中糧。

translations.literal: Grain in the city was seized.
translations.idiomatic: Grain in the city was requisitioned.

sentences.zh: 知歸德府事石盞女魯懽為樞密副使、權參知政事。

translations.literal: Guide Prefect Shidan Nülühuan was made Privy Vice Marshal and Acting Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Guide prefect Shidan Nülühuan became privy vice marshal and acting participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 留元帥官奴忠孝軍四百五十人，都尉馬用軍二百八十餘人，發餘軍赴宿、徐、陳三州就糧。

translations.literal: Guannu's four hundred fifty Loyal-and-Filial troops and Commandant Ma Yong's two hundred eighty-odd men were kept; the rest of the army was sent to Su, Xu, and Chen for grain.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred fifty of Guannu's Loyal-and-Filial troops and Ma Yong's two hundred eighty-odd men were retained; the remaining forces were sent to Su, Xu, and Chen for provisions.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，石盞女魯懽乞盡散衛兵出城就食。

translations.literal: Third month, yichou: Nülühuan asked to disperse all guards outside the city for food.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, Nülühuan asked to send all guards outside the walls to forage.

sentences.zh: 官奴私與國用安謀，邀上幸海州，不從。

translations.literal: Guannu secretly plotted with Guo Yong'an to invite the emperor to Haizhou; the emperor refused.
translations.idiomatic: Guannu secretly colluded with Guo Yong'an to urge an imperial visit to Haizhou; the emperor declined.

sentences.zh: 蔡帥烏石論鎬以糧四百餘斛至歸德，表請臨幸，上遣學士烏石論蒲鮮以幸蔡之意諭其州人。

translations.literal: Cai commander Wushulun Hao brought more than four hundred hu of grain to Guide and memorialized asking the emperor to visit; the emperor sent academician Wushulun Puxian to announce the intent to favor Cai to the prefectural people.
translations.idiomatic: Cai commander Wushulun Hao delivered more than four hundred hu of grain to Guide and petitioned for an imperial visit; the emperor sent academician Wushulun Puxian to tell the people of the prefecture that he meant to favor Cai.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，官奴以忠孝軍為亂，攻殺馬用，遂殺尚書左丞李蹊、參知政事石盞女魯懽、點檢徒單長樂，從官右丞已下三百餘人。

translations.literal: On wuchen Guan Nu raised the Loyal-Benevolence Army in revolt, attacked and killed Ma Yong, then killed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Li Xi, Participation Councillor Shi Zannü Luhuan, Inspector Tushan Changle, and more than three hundred attendants from the right vice director down.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Guan Nu mutinied with the Loyal-Benevolence Army, killed Ma Yong, then slew Li Xi, Shi Zannü Luhuan, Tushan Changle, and over three hundred courtiers through the right vice director.

sentences.zh: 上赦官奴，暴女魯懽罪狀，以官奴為樞密副使、權參知政事，左右司郎中張天綱為戶部侍郎、權參知政事。

translations.literal: The emperor pardoned Guan Nu, published Shi Zannü Luhuan’s crimes, made Guan Nu acting privy deputy and participation councillor, and Zhang Tiangang of the Left and Right Bureau a vice minister of revenue and acting participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned Guan Nu, exposed Shi Zannü Luhuan’s guilt, named Guan Nu acting privy deputy and participation councillor, and made Bureau director Zhang Tiangang vice minister of revenue and acting participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，官奴真授參知政事，兼左副元帥。

translations.literal: On xinmao Guan Nu was formally appointed participation councillor and also left deputy marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Guan Nu received formal appointment as participation councillor and left deputy marshal.

sentences.zh: 官奴以上居照碧堂，禁近諸臣無一人敢奏對者。

translations.literal: Guan Nu lived above the emperor in the Zhaobi Hall; none of the inner-court ministers dared present memorials or audience.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Nu lodged above the emperor in the Zhaobi Hall, and no inner-court minister dared address him.

sentences.zh: 上日悲泣言曰：「自古無不亡之國、不死之主，但恨朕不知用人，致為此奴所囚耳。

translations.literal: Daily the emperor wept and said: "From antiquity there has been no state that did not perish and no ruler who did not die; I only regret that I did not know how to employ men and was brought to be imprisoned by this slave."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept daily: "Every state falls and every ruler dies; I only regret misjudging men and letting this slave hold me prisoner."

sentences.zh: 」遂與內局令宋圭等謀誅官奴。

translations.literal: He then plotted with Inner Service director Song Gui and others to kill Guan Nu.
translations.idiomatic: He then plotted with Inner Service director Song Gui and others to kill Guan Nu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，徐州行省完顏忽斜貢執王德全並其子誅之，及其党王琳、楊璝、斜卯延壽。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu: Xuzhou Traveling Secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu arrested Wang Dequan and his son and executed them, together with their partisans Wang Lin, Yang Jin, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on renwu, Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu seized Wang Dequan and his son and executed them with partisans Wang Lin, Yang Jin, and Xie Mao Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 召經歷商瑀用之。

translations.literal: Registrar Shang Yu was summoned and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Registrar Shang Yu was recalled to service.

sentences.zh: 魚山從宜嚴祿叛歸漣水。

translations.literal: Yushan attendant Yan Lu rebelled and returned to Lianshui.
translations.idiomatic: Yushan attendant Yan Lu rebelled and fled to Lianshui.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，陳州都尉李順兒殺行省粘葛奴申及招撫使劉天起，送款于崔立。

translations.literal: On gengyin Chenzhou commandant Li Shun’er killed traveling secretariat Nian Ge Nushen and pacification commissioner Liu Tianqi and submitted to Cui Li.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Chenzhou commandant Li Shun’er killed traveling secretariat Nian Ge Nushen and pacification commissioner Liu Tianqi and surrendered to Cui Li.

sentences.zh: 張俊民、李琦奔汴京。

translations.literal: Zhang Junmin and Li Qi fled to Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Junmin and Li Qi fled to Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 王壁還歸德。

translations.literal: Wang Bi returned to Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bi withdrew to Guide.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，崔立以梁王從恪、荊王守純及及諸宗室男女五百餘人至青城，皆及於難。

translations.literal: On guisi Cui Li took Prince of Liang Cong Ke, Prince of Jing Shou Chun, and more than five hundred men and women of the imperial clan to Qingcheng; all perished.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Cui Li led the Prince of Liang Cong Ke, the Prince of Jing Shou Chun, and over five hundred imperial clansmen to Qingcheng, where all were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，兩宮北遷。

translations.literal: On jiawu the two palaces moved north.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the two palaces went north.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄧州節度使移剌瑗以其城叛，與白華俱亡入宋。

translations.literal: On jiachen Dengzhou military commissioner Yila Yuan rebelled with his city and fled into Song with Bai Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Dengzhou military commissioner Yila Yuan turned his city and fled into Song with Bai Hua.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，官奴及其党阿裏合、白進皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao: Guan Nu and his partisans Ali He and Bai Jin were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, Guan Nu and partisans Ali He and Bai Jin were executed.

sentences.zh: 上禦雙門，赦忠孝軍，以安反側。

translations.literal: The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-Benevolence Army, and settled the shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-Benevolence Army, and calmed the unrest.

sentences.zh: 遂決策遷蔡，詔蔡、息、陳、潁各以兵來迓。

translations.literal: He then resolved to move to Cai and ordered Cai, Xi, Chen, and Ying each to bring troops to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: He then decided on Caizhou and ordered Cai, Xi, Chen, and Ying to march troops to receive him.

sentences.zh: 中京留守、權參政烏林答胡土棄城奔蔡。

translations.literal: Central Capital defender and acting participation councillor Ulinada Hutou abandoned the city and fled to Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital defender and acting participation councillor Ulinada Hutou abandoned the city and fled to Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，中京破，留守兼便宜總帥強伸死之。

translations.literal: On renwu the Central Capital fell; defender and acting expedient supreme commander Qiang Shen died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Central Capital fell; defender and acting expedient supreme commander Qiang Shen was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，召徐州行省完顏忽斜虎赴行在所，以抹撚兀典代行省事，郭恩為總帥兼節度使。

translations.literal: On wuzi Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu was summoned to the mobile court; Monian Wudian replaced him in the traveling secretariat, and Guo En became supreme commander and military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu was called to the mobile court; Monian Wudian took the traveling secretariat and Guo En became supreme commander and military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上發歸德，留元帥王璧守之。

translations.literal: On xinmao the emperor left Guide and left Marshal Wang Bi to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor departed Guide, leaving Marshal Wang Bi to hold it.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次亳州。

translations.literal: On renchen he halted at Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he stopped at Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以亳州節度使王進、同知節度使王賓征民丁運鐵甲糗糧，留權參政張天綱董之，就遷有功將士。

translations.literal: On guisi Bozhou military commissioner Wang Jin and vice commissioner Wang Bin were ordered to levy men to transport iron armor and grain; acting participation councillor Zhang Tiangang was left to supervise, with promotion for meritorious officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Bozhou commissioner Wang Jin and vice commissioner Wang Bin levied men for iron armor and grain; acting participation councillor Zhang Tiangang oversaw the work and promoted deserving troops.

sentences.zh: 臨淄郡王王義深據靈璧望口寨以叛，遣近侍直長女奚烈完出將徐、宿兵討之，義深敗走漣水，入宋。

translations.literal: Linzi Prince Wang Yishen held Wangkou stockade at Lingbi in revolt; a nearby attendant chief Nüxilie Wan led Xu and Su troops against him; Yishen was beaten and fled to Lianshui and entered Song.
translations.idiomatic: Linzi Prince Wang Yishen rebelled at Lingbi’s Wangkou stockade; attendant chief Nüxilie Wan led Xu and Su troops against him; Yishen was routed, fled to Lianshui, and entered Song.

sentences.zh: 丙申，亳州鎮防軍崔複哥殺守臣王賓等，張天綱以便宜授複哥節度使，罷運鐵甲糗糧，州人乃安。

translations.literal: On bingchen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang by expedient authority made Fuge military commissioner, halted the iron-armor and grain transport, and the prefecture was calmed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang made Fuge military commissioner on his own authority, stopped the armor-and-grain levy, and the prefecture settled.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上入蔡州，詔尚書省為書召武仙會兵入援。

translations.literal: On jihai the emperor entered Caizhou and ordered the Masters of Writing to draft summons for Wu Xian to unite troops in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor entered Caizhou and ordered the Masters of Writing to summon Wu Xian to rally relief troops.

sentences.zh: 徐州行省抹撚兀典赴蔡州。

translations.literal: Xuzhou traveling secretariat Monian Wudian went to Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou traveling secretariat Monian Wudian proceeded to Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 起複右丞相致仕賽不代行省事。

translations.literal: Retired Right Chancellor Saibu was recalled to replace the traveling secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Retired right chancellor Saibu was recalled to head the traveling secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七月癸卯朔，曲赦蔡州管內雜犯死罪以下。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guimao new moon: a partial amnesty within Caizhou for miscellaneous offenses below capital death.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month’s guimao new moon Caizhou received partial amnesty for miscellaneous crimes short of capital death.

sentences.zh: 官吏軍民普覃兩官，經應辦者更遷一官。

translations.literal: Officials, soldiers, and civilians all received two ranks; those who had met levies were advanced one more rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, troops, and people all gained two ranks; those who had met requisitions gained another.

sentences.zh: 弛門禁，通眾貨，蔡人便之。

translations.literal: Gate curfews were relaxed and goods circulated freely; the people of Cai were eased.
translations.idiomatic: Gate restrictions were lifted, trade opened, and the people of Caizhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以烏古論鎬為御史大夫，總帥如故，張天綱為御史中丞，仍權參政，完顏藥師為鎮南軍節度使，兼蔡州管內觀察使。

translations.literal: On yisi Urgun Hao was made censor-in-chief with his supreme command unchanged; Zhang Tiangang was censor-in-chief and still acting participation councillor; Wanyan Yaoshi was Pacify-South Army military commissioner and also Caizhou circuit observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Urgun Hao became censor-in-chief while keeping supreme command; Zhang Tiangang became chief censor and remained acting participation councillor; Wanyan Yaoshi was named Pacify-South Army military commissioner and Caizhou observer.

sentences.zh: 戊申，左右司郎中烏古論蒲鮮兼息州刺史，權元帥右都監，行帥府事。

translations.literal: On wushen Bureau director Urgun Puxian was also Xi Prefecture prefect, acting right marshalate supervisor, and acting marshal headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Bureau director Urgun Puxian was also made Xi prefect, acting right marshalate supervisor, and acting marshal headquarters.

sentences.zh: 征行元帥權總帥婁室簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: Campaigning marshal and acting supreme commander Loushi signed Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning marshal and acting supreme commander Loushi joined the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 己酉，選室女備宮中使令，已得數人，以右丞忽斜虎諫，留識文義者一人，餘聽自便。

translations.literal: On jiyou palace women were selected for inner service; several had been obtained when right vice director Huxiehu remonstrated, leaving one who knew writing and dismissing the rest as they wished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou palace girls were drafted for inner service; after several were taken, right vice director Huxiehu protested, leaving one literate girl and releasing the rest.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣魏璠征武仙兵。

translations.literal: On yimao Wei Jun was sent to summon Wu Xian’s troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wei Jun was dispatched to rally Wu Xian’s army.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，護衛蒲鮮石魯負祖宗禦容至自汴，敕有司奉安於乾元寺。

translations.literal: On dingsi guard Puxian Shilu bore the imperial ancestors’ portraits from Bian; an edict ordered the relevant offices to install them at Qianyuan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi guard Puxian Shilu brought the imperial ancestors’ portraits from Bian; the throne ordered them installed at Qianyuan Temple.

sentences.zh: 前御史中丞蒲察世達、西面元帥把撒合自汴來歸。

translations.literal: Former chief censor Pucha Shida and western marshal Bashu He returned from Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Former chief censor Pucha Shida and western marshal Bashu He came back from Bian.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，武仙劫將士，謀取宋金州，至淅水眾潰。

translations.literal: On xinyou Wu Xian coerced his officers and plotted to seize Song’s Jin Prefecture; reaching the Xi River his force collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Wu Xian bullied his officers into raiding Song’s Jin Prefecture; at the Xi River the army broke up.

sentences.zh: 行六部尚書盧芝、侍郎石玠謀歸蔡州，仙追芝不及，遂殺玠。

translations.literal: Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jue plotted to return to Caizhou; Wu Xian pursued Zhi without catching him and killed Jue.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jue plotted to flee to Caizhou; Wu Xian chased Zhi in vain and killed Jue.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，定進馬遷賞格，又定括馬罪格，以簽樞密院事權參政事抹撚兀典領其事。

translations.literal: On dingmao standards were set for rewards for presenting horses and penalties for seizing horses; acting participation councillor and privy signer Monian Wudian oversaw the matter.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao rewards for presenting horses and penalties for unauthorized seizure were fixed; privy signer and acting participation councillor Monian Wudian directed it.

sentences.zh: 遣使分詣諸道，選兵會于蔡。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent on every route to select troops to assemble at Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys on every circuit were told to choose troops to gather at Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以蒲察世達為吏部侍郎，權行六部尚書。

translations.literal: On jisi Pucha Shida was made vice minister of personnel and acting traveling Six Ministries director.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Pucha Shida became vice minister of personnel and acting traveling Six Ministries director.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉朔，以秦州元帥粘哥完展權參知政事，行省事於陝西。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guiyou new moon: Qinzhou marshal Nian’ge Wanzhan was made acting participation councillor and traveling secretariat in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month’s guiyou new moon Qinzhou marshal Nian’ge Wanzhan was named acting participation councillor and Shaanxi traveling secretariat.

sentences.zh: 諭以蠟書，期九月中徵兵上會于饒豐關，欲出宋不意，以取興元。

translations.literal: He was instructed by wax letter that in the ninth month troops were to assemble at Raofeng Pass, intending to strike Xingyuan before Song expected it.
translations.idiomatic: A wax letter told him to muster troops at Raofeng Pass in the ninth month and take Xingyuan before Song could react.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大元使王楫諭宋還，宋以軍護其行，青山招撫盧進得邏吏言以聞，上為之懼。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Great Yuan envoy Wang Ji returned from instructing Song; Song sent troops to escort his departure; Qingshan pacification commissioner Lu Jin learned from a Jin clerk and reported it; the emperor was afraid.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Great Yuan envoy Wang Ji came back from ordering Song; Song escorted him out; Qingshan pacifier Lu Jin heard from a Jin clerk and reported it, and the emperor was alarmed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上閱兵於見山亭。

translations.literal: On dingchou the emperor reviewed troops at Jianshan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the emperor inspected troops at Jianshan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，元帥楚曁弁複立壽州于蒙城，詔遷賞有差，州縣官皆令真授。

translations.literal: On guiwei Marshal Chu Zan Bian restored Shou Prefecture at Mengcheng; an edict graded rewards and ordered prefectural and county officials formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Marshal Chu Zan Bian re-established Shou Prefecture at Mengcheng; rewards were graded and local officials were given formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大元召宋兵攻唐州，元帥右監軍烏古論黑漢死于戰，主帥蒲察某為部曲兵所食。

translations.literal: On yiyou Great Yuan summoned Song troops to attack Tang Prefecture; right marshalate supervisor Urgun Heihan died in battle, and commander Pucha Mou was eaten by his own troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Great Yuan called Song to attack Tang Prefecture; right marshalate supervisor Urgun Heihan was killed, and commander Pucha Mou was devoured by his own men.

sentences.zh: 城破，宋人求食人者盡戮之，餘無所犯。

translations.literal: The city fell; Song men seeking those who had eaten human flesh executed them all — otherwise they did no harm.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Song troops hunting cannibals killed them all and otherwise did no harm.

sentences.zh: 宋人駐兵息州南。

translations.literal: Song troops encamped south of Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces camped south of Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔權參政抹撚兀典、簽樞密院事婁室行省、院於息州。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict ordered acting Participation Councillor Monian Udian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to run the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict sent acting Participation Councillor Monian Udian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to head the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，烏古論鎬權參知政事，兀林答胡土為殿前都點檢。

translations.literal: On dinghai Wugulun Gao was acting Participation Councillor; Ulinada Hutu was Chief Palace Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wugulun Gao became acting Participation Councillor and Ulinada Hutu was made Chief Palace Inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，初設四隅機察官。

translations.literal: On gengyin four-corner surveillance officers were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin four-corner surveillance posts were created for the first time.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，息州行省抹撚兀典以兵襲宋人中渡店，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: On renchen Xi traveling secretariat Monian Udian with troops raided Song at Zhongdu Ford and took many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Monian Udian at the Xi traveling secretariat raided Song at Zhongdu Ford with heavy kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 乙未，萬年節，州郡以表來賀二十餘所。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the Ten-Thousand-Years Day, more than twenty prefectures sent congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the emperor's birthday, over twenty prefectures sent congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，設四隅和糴官及惠民司，以太醫數人更直，病人官給以藥，仍擇年老進士二人為醫藥官。

translations.literal: On xinchou four-corner fair-purchase officers and a Beneficent Bureau were set up; several imperial physicians took turns on duty, the sick were given medicine by the state, and two elderly jinshi were chosen as medical officers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou fair-purchase officers for the four quarters and a Beneficent Bureau were established; imperial physicians rotated to treat the sick at state expense, and two elderly jinshi were named medical officers.

sentences.zh: 是月，假蔡州都軍致仕內族阿虎帶同僉大睦親府事，使宋借糧，入辭，上諭之曰：「宋人負朕深矣。

translations.literal: That month, acting Caizhou commander, retired, inner-clan Ahu Dai, concurrent associate of the Great Kinship Bureau, was sent to Song to borrow grain; at his farewell audience the emperor instructed him, saying, "Song has deeply wronged Us.
translations.idiomatic: That month retired acting Caizhou commander, inner-clan Ahu Dai, also associate of the Great Kinship Bureau, was sent to Song for grain; at his farewell the emperor said, "Song has deeply wronged me.

sentences.zh: 朕自即位以來，戒飭邊將無犯南界。

translations.literal: Since We took the throne We have warned frontier generals not to violate the southern border.
translations.idiomatic: Since I took the throne I have warned frontier generals not to cross the southern border.

sentences.zh: 邊臣有自請征討者，未嘗不切責之。

translations.literal: When border officers themselves asked to campaign, We never failed to rebuke them sharply.
translations.idiomatic: When border officers asked to attack on their own, I never failed to rebuke them harshly.

sentences.zh: 向得宋一州，隨即付與。

translations.literal: Whenever We gained a Song prefecture We at once returned it.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever we took a Song prefecture we returned it at once.

sentences.zh: 近淮陰來歸，彼多以金幣為贖，朕若受財，是貨之也，付之全城，秋毫無犯。

translations.literal: Recently Huaiyin came over to Us; they often tried to redeem people with gold and silk — had We accepted wealth, that would have been selling them; We restored the whole city without the slightest harm.
translations.idiomatic: When Huaiyin recently submitted, they often tried to ransom people with gold and silk — had I taken payment I would have sold them; I restored the whole city untouched.

sentences.zh: 清口臨陣生獲數千人，悉以資糧遣之。

translations.literal: At Qingkou We captured several thousand alive in battle and sent them all away with provisions.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingkou we captured several thousand alive in battle and sent them all away with rations.

sentences.zh: 今乘我疲敝，據我壽州，誘我鄧州，又攻我唐州，彼為謀亦淺矣。

translations.literal: Now they take advantage of Our exhaustion, hold Our Shouzhou, lure Our Dengzhou, and also attack Our Tangzhou — their scheming is shallow indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Now they exploit our weakness, hold Shouzhou, lure Dengzhou, and attack Tangzhou — their plotting is shallow indeed.

sentences.zh: 大元滅國四十，以及西夏，夏亡必及於我。

translations.literal: Great Yuan has destroyed forty states, and even Xia — when Xia perishes it must reach Us.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan has destroyed forty states and Xia as well — when Xia falls it must reach us.

sentences.zh: 我亡必乃于宋。

translations.literal: When We perish it will certainly be through Song.
translations.idiomatic: When we perish it will surely be through Song.

sentences.zh: 脣亡齒寒，自然之理。

translations.literal: When the lips are gone the teeth grow cold — nature's law.
translations.idiomatic: When the lips are gone the teeth grow cold — that is nature's law.

sentences.zh: 若與我連和，所以為我者亦為彼也。

translations.literal: If you ally with Us, what serves Us also serves you.
translations.idiomatic: If you ally with us, what helps us also helps you.

sentences.zh: 卿其以此曉之。

translations.literal: You should enlighten them with this."
translations.idiomatic: Explain this to them."

sentences.zh: 」至宋，宋不許。

translations.literal: " Arriving in Song, Song did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " In Song, Song refused.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，魯山元帥元志率兵入援，賜以大信牌，升為總帥。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wushen: Lushan marshal Yuan Zhi led troops in relief and was given a great trust-plaque and promoted to commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen, Lushan marshal Yuan Zhi marched in relief, received a great trust-plaque, and was promoted to commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以重九拜天于節度使査，群臣陪從成禮，上面諭之曰：「國家自開創涵養汝等百有餘年。

translations.literal: On gengxu, for the Double Ninth, Heaven was worshiped at the military commissioner's hall; ministers attended in full ritual; the emperor addressed them, saying, "The state has nurtured you for more than a hundred years since its founding.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, on the Double Ninth, the emperor worshiped Heaven at the military commissioner's hall with the ministers in full rites and said, "The state has nurtured you for over a hundred years since its founding.

sentences.zh: 汝等或以先世立功，或以勞效起身，被堅執銳，積有年矣。

translations.literal: Some of you rose through forebears' merit, some through labor and service; bearing armor and wielding blades, you have accumulated years of it.
translations.idiomatic: Some of you rose on ancestors' merit, some on service; in armor and arms you have done so for years.

sentences.zh: 今當厄運，與朕同患，可謂忠矣。

translations.literal: Now at ill fortune you share Our affliction — that may be called loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Now in hard times you share my plight — that is loyalty.

sentences.zh: 比聞北兵將至，正汝等立功報國之秋，縱死王事，不失為忠孝之鬼。

translations.literal: We hear northern troops are coming — this is the season for you to win merit and repay the state; even dying in the sovereign's service, you would not fail to be loyal and filial ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: I hear northern troops are coming — this is your season to serve the state; die in battle and you will still be loyal, filial ghosts.

sentences.zh: 往者汝等立功，常慮不為朝廷所知，今日臨敵，朕親見之矣，汝等勉之。

translations.literal: In the past when you won merit you often feared the court would not know; today facing the enemy We see it in person — strive on."
translations.idiomatic: Before, when you won merit you feared the court would not know; today, facing the enemy, I see it myself — do your best."

sentences.zh: 」因賜卮酒。

translations.literal: " He then bestowed goblets of wine.
translations.idiomatic: " He then gave them cups of wine.

sentences.zh: 酒未竟，邏騎馳奏，敵兵數百突至城下。

translations.literal: Before the wine was finished, scouts galloped in reporting several hundred enemy troops had suddenly reached below the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Before the wine was done, scouts galloped in reporting several hundred enemy troops had rushed to the foot of the wall.

sentences.zh: 將士踴躍咸請一戰，上許之。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers eagerly all asked for one battle; the emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers eagerly asked to fight; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，分軍防守四面及子城，以總帥孛朮魯婁室守東面，內族承麟副之；

translations.literal: That day the army was divided to defend the four sides and the subsidiary wall; Commander-in-Chief Beipailu Lou Shi held the east, inner-clan Chenglin as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: That day troops were split to hold the four faces and subsidiary wall; Commander-in-Chief Beipailu Lou Shi held the east with inner-clan Chenglin as deputy;

sentences.zh: 參知政事烏古論鎬守南面，總帥元志副之；

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Wugulun Gao held the south, Commander-in-Chief Yuan Zhi as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Wugulun Gao held the south with Commander-in-Chief Yuan Zhi as deputy;

sentences.zh: 殿前都點檢兀林答胡土守西面，忠孝軍元帥蔡八兒副之；

translations.literal: Chief Palace Inspector Ulinada Hutu held the west, Loyal-and-Filial Army marshal Cai Ba'er as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Chief Palace Inspector Ulinada Hutu held the west with Loyal-and-Filial Army marshal Cai Ba'er as deputy;

sentences.zh: 忠孝軍元帥、權殿前右副點檢王山兒守北面，元帥紇石烈柏壽副之；

translations.literal: Loyal-and-Filial Army marshal, acting Right Deputy Chief Inspector Wang Shan'er held the north, marshal Geshilie Baishou as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Loyal-and-Filial marshal and acting Right Deputy Chief Inspector Wang Shan'er held the north with marshal Geshilie Baishou as deputy;

sentences.zh: 遙授西安軍節度使兼殿前右衛將軍、行元帥府事女奚烈出守東南，元帥左都監夾谷當哥副之；

translations.literal: Remotely appointed Xi'an Army Military Commissioner and Right Palace Guard general, acting marshalate affairs Nuxilie Chu held the southeast, marshalate left overseer Jiagu Dangge as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Remotely appointed Xi'an Army commissioner and Right Palace Guard general Nuxilie Chu, acting marshalate affairs, held the southeast with left overseer Jiagu Dangge as deputy;

sentences.zh: 殿前右衛將軍、權左副都點檢內族斜烈守子城，都尉王愛實副之。

translations.literal: Right Palace Guard general, acting Left Deputy Chief Inspector, inner-clan Xielie held the subsidiary wall, Colonel Wang Aishi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Right Palace Guard general and acting Left Deputy Chief Inspector, inner-clan Xielie, held the subsidiary wall with Colonel Wang Aishi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大元兵築長壘圍蔡城。

translations.literal: On xinhai Great Yuan troops built long ramparts and besieged Cai city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Great Yuan forces built long ramparts and besieged Cai.

sentences.zh: 己未，括蔡城粟。

translations.literal: On jiwei Cai grain was requisitioned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Cai grain was seized.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禁公私釀酒。

translations.literal: On xinyou private and public brewing were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou private and public brewing were banned.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅，更造「天興寶會」。

translations.literal: Tenth month, wuyin: "Heaven's Revival Treasure Assembly" was reminted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuyin, the Tianxing Treasure Assembly coin was reminted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，縱饑民老稚羸疾者出城。

translations.literal: On xinsi starving civilians — old, young, weak, and sick — were released from the city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the starving — old, young, weak, and sick — were let out of the city.

sentences.zh: 癸未，徐州守臣郭恩殺逐官吏以叛，行省賽不死之。

translations.literal: On guimao Xuzhou defender Guo En killed and expelled officials in rebellion; the traveling secretariat Saib put him to death.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Xuzhou defender Guo En killed and drove out officials in revolt; traveling secretariat chief Saib executed him.

sentences.zh: 甲申，給饑民船，聽采城壕菱芡水草以食。

translations.literal: On jiashen boats were given to starving people, who were allowed to gather water chestnuts, gorgon seeds, and aquatic plants from the moat for food.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen starving people were given boats and allowed to harvest water chestnuts, gorgon, and plants from the moat.

sentences.zh: 戊子，征諸道兵。

translations.literal: On wuzi troops were levied from all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi troops were mobilized from every circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上閱射於子城，中者賞麥有差。

translations.literal: On xinmao the emperor reviewed archery at the subsidiary wall; hits were rewarded with graded amounts of wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor held an archery review at the subsidiary wall and rewarded hits with wheat in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，殿前左副都點檢溫敦昌孫戰歿。

translations.literal: On bingchen Left Deputy Chief Inspector Wendun Changsun died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Left Deputy Chief Inspector Wendun Changsun was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賜義軍戰歿被創者麥。

translations.literal: On wuxu wheat was granted to Loyal Army men killed or wounded in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu wheat was given to Loyal Army dead and wounded.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑朔，以右副都點檢阿勒根移失剌為宣差鎮撫都彈壓，別設彈壓四員副之，四隅機察亦隸焉。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinchou new moon: Right Deputy Chief Inspector Alegen Yishila was made envoy commissioner for pacification and supreme suppression, with four separate suppressors as deputies; four-corner surveillance was also placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's xinchou new moon, Right Deputy Chief Inspector Alegen Yishila was made envoy commissioner for pacification and supreme suppression with four deputy suppressors, and four-corner surveillance was subordinated to him.

sentences.zh: 宋遣其將江海、孟珙帥兵萬人，獻糧三十萬石助大元兵攻蔡。

translations.literal: Song sent its generals Jiang Hai and Meng Gong leading ten thousand men, presenting three hundred thousand shi of grain to help Great Yuan troops attack Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent generals Jiang Hai and Meng Gong with ten thousand men and three hundred thousand shi of grain to aid Great Yuan forces attacking Cai.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，盡籍民丁防守，括婦人壯捷者假男子衣冠，運大石。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu: all male population was registered for defense; strong, agile women were pressed, given men's dress, and made to haul heavy stones.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, every man was registered for defense and strong women were dressed as men and forced to haul heavy stones.

sentences.zh: 上親出撫軍。

translations.literal: The emperor personally went out to encourage the troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went out in person to hearten the army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大元兵決練江，宋兵決柴潭入汝水。

translations.literal: On dingchou Great Yuan troops breached the Lian River; Song troops breached Chaitan into the Ru River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Great Yuan forces broke the Lian River line; Song forces cut through Chaitan into the Ru River.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大元兵破外城，宿州副總帥高剌哥戰歿。

translations.literal: On jimao Great Yuan troops broke the outer wall; Suzhou deputy commander-in-chief Gao Lage died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Great Yuan forces stormed the outer wall; Suzhou deputy commander Gao Lage was killed fighting.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以總帥孛朮魯婁室、殿前都點檢兀林答胡土皆權參政，都尉完顏承麟為東面元帥，權總帥。

translations.literal: On xinsi Commander-in-Chief Boluolushi and Palace Front Inspector Ulinada Hutu were both made acting participation councillors; Commandant Wanyan Chenglin was made Eastern Marshal and acting commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi commander-in-chief Boluolushi and palace front inspector Ulinada Hutu were both named acting participation councillors; commandant Wanyan Chenglin became eastern marshal and acting commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大元兵墮西城，上謂侍臣曰：「我為金紫十年，太子十年，人主十年，自知無大過惡，死無恨矣。

translations.literal: On jichou Great Yuan troops stormed the western wall. The emperor told his attendants: "I wore purple rank ten years, was crown prince ten years, and have ruled ten years. I know myself free of great faults and evils — I can die without regret.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Great Yuan forces took the western wall. The emperor told his attendants, "Ten years in purple rank, ten as heir, ten on the throne — I know I have no grave fault. I can die without regret.

sentences.zh: 所恨者祖宗傳祚百年，至我而絕，與自古荒淫暴亂之君等為亡國，獨此為介介耳。

translations.literal: What I regret is that our ancestors’ mandate lasted a hundred years and ends with me — to perish like the ancient dissolute and violent rulers, that alone is what gnaws at me."
translations.idiomatic: What I regret is that a hundred years of our ancestors’ mandate ends with me — to fall like the ancient dissolute, violent kings. That alone stings."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「古無不亡之國，亡國之君往往為人囚縶，或為俘獻，或辱於階庭，閉之空穀。

translations.literal: He also said: "From antiquity no state does not perish. Fallen rulers are often made prisoners, sent as captives, shamed in the enemy court, or shut in empty valleys.
translations.idiomatic: He added, "No state lasts forever. Fallen rulers are often imprisoned, paraded as captives, shamed in the victor’s hall, or locked in empty valleys.

sentences.zh: 朕必不至於此。

translations.literal: I shall certainly not come to that."
translations.idiomatic: I will never come to that."

sentences.zh: 卿等觀之，朕志決矣。

translations.literal: You may see — my mind is made up."
translations.idiomatic: Mark it — my mind is made up."

sentences.zh: 」都尉王愛實戰歿。

translations.literal: Commandant Wang Aishi died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Wang Aishi was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 砲軍總帥王銳殺元帥谷當哥，率三十人降大元。

translations.literal: Artillery Corps commander-in-chief Wang Rui killed Marshal Gudangge and led thirty men in surrender to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Catapult corps commander Wang Rui killed marshal Gudangge and surrendered to Great Yuan with thirty men.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以御用器皿賞戰士。

translations.literal: On gengyin imperial vessels were used to reward the warriors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court gave imperial wares to reward the fighters.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上微服率兵夜出東城謀遁，及柵不果，戰而還。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor, in plain dress, led troops out by night through the eastern gate intending to flee; reaching the palisade he could not get through, fought, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor, disguised, led troops out the eastern gate at night to escape; blocked at the palisade, he fought his way back.

sentences.zh: 乙未，殺尚廄馬五十疋、官馬一百五十疋犒將士。

translations.literal: On yiwei fifty imperial stable horses and one hundred fifty official horses were killed to feast the commanders and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei fifty imperial stud horses and one hundred fifty government horses were slaughtered to feast officers and men.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬寅，冊柴潭神為護國靈應王。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, on renyin the Chaitan spirit was enfeoffed as Protect-the-State Spirit-Responsive King.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month, on renyin the Chaitan spirit was made Protect-the-State Spirit-Responsive King.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以近侍分守四城。

translations.literal: On jiachen palace attendants were assigned to guard each of the four walls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen inner attendants were posted to hold the four walls.

sentences.zh: 戊申，夜，上集百官，傳位於東面元帥承麟，承麟固讓。

translations.literal: On wushen, at night, the emperor gathered the hundred officials and transmitted the throne to Eastern Marshal Chenglin; Chenglin firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: That night, on wushen, the emperor assembled the officials and abdicated to eastern marshal Chenglin, who refused again and again.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕所以付卿者，豈得已哉？

translations.literal: The edict said: "The reason I entrust this to you — could it be my wish?"
translations.idiomatic: The edict read, "Why I hand this to you — do you think I want to?"

sentences.zh: 以肌體肥重，不便鞍馬馳突。

translations.literal: My body is heavy and ill-suited to saddle and sudden charge.
translations.idiomatic: My body is too heavy for the saddle and a hard ride.

sentences.zh: 卿平日髂捷有將略，萬一得免，祚胤不絕，此朕志也。

translations.literal: You are by nature nimble in the thigh and skilled in command; if by any chance you escape, the line need not end — that is my hope."
translations.idiomatic: You are quick in the saddle and know command; if you somehow break free, the line need not die — that is what I hope for."

sentences.zh: 」己酉，承麟即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On jiyou Chenglin assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Chenglin took the throne.

sentences.zh: 百官稱賀。

translations.literal: The hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The officials congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，亟出捍敵，而南面已立幟。

translations.literal: When the rites were done he rushed out to repel the enemy, but banners were already raised on the southern wall.
translations.idiomatic: The rites barely finished, he ran out to fight the enemy — yet banners already flew on the southern wall.

sentences.zh: 俄頃，四面呼聲震天地。

translations.literal: In a moment shouts shook heaven and earth on every side.
translations.idiomatic: In moments cries shook heaven and earth from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 南面守者棄門，大軍入，與城中軍巷戰，城中軍不能禦。

translations.literal: The southern defenders abandoned the gate; the great army entered and fought the city troops in the lanes — the city troops could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: Southern guards dropped the gate; the main force poured in and fought street by street — the garrison could not hold.

sentences.zh: 帝自縊于幽蘭軒。

translations.literal: The emperor hanged himself in the Youlan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hanged himself in the Youlan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 末帝退保子城，聞帝崩，率群臣入哭，諡曰哀宗。

translations.literal: The Last Emperor fell back to the inner citadel; hearing the emperor had died, he led the hundred officials in to mourn and gave the posthumous title Aizong.
translations.idiomatic: The last emperor withdrew to the inner citadel; learning the emperor was dead, he led the officials in mourning and gave the posthumous title Aizong.

sentences.zh: 哭奠未畢，城潰，諸禁近舉火焚之。

translations.literal: Before the mourning was finished the city burst; all the close attendants set fires and burned it.
translations.idiomatic: Before mourning ended the walls gave way; inner attendants set fires and burned what remained.

sentences.zh: 奉禦絳山收哀宗骨瘞之汝水上。

translations.literal: Palace attendant Jiangshan gathered Aizong’s bones and buried them on the Ru River.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant Jiangshan collected Aizong’s remains and buried them on the Ru River bank.

sentences.zh: 末帝為亂兵所害，金亡。

translations.literal: The Last Emperor was killed by mutinous troops; Jin perished.
translations.idiomatic: The last emperor was killed by mutinous soldiers; Jin was no more.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：金之初興，天下莫強焉。

translations.literal: Appraisal: At Jin’s first rise, none under heaven was its match.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: When Jin first rose, nothing under heaven could stand against it.

sentences.zh: 太祖、太宗威制中國，大概欲效遼初故事，立楚立齊，委而去之，宋人不競，遂失故物。

translations.literal: Taizu and Taizong overawed China, broadly intending to follow Liao’s early example of setting up Chu and Qi, entrusting them, and withdrawing — Song did not compete and thus lost what it once held.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu and Taizong dominated China, mostly copying Liao’s early tactic of setting up Chu and Qi, handing them off, and pulling back — Song failed to contest it and lost its old holdings.

sentences.zh: 熙宗、海陵濟以虐政，中原觖望，金事幾去。

translations.literal: Xizong and Hailing added cruel government; the Central Plains turned away in hope, and Jin nearly passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Xizong and Hailing piled on harsh rule; the heartland lost faith and Jin nearly ended then.

sentences.zh: 天厭南北之兵，挺生世宗，以仁易暴，休息斯民。

translations.literal: Heaven wearied of warfare between north and south; Shizong was born, replaced violence with benevolence, and let the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven tired of north–south war; Shizong came, traded cruelty for mercy, and gave the people rest.

sentences.zh: 是故金祚百有餘年，由大定之政有以固結人心，乃克爾也。

translations.literal: Thus Jin’s fortune lasted more than a hundred years — because the Great Settlement reign truly bound hearts could it hold so long.
translations.idiomatic: So Jin endured more than a century — the Great Settlement reign really knit hearts together, and only thus did it last.

sentences.zh: 章宗志存潤色，而秕政日多，誅求無藝，民力浸竭，明昌、承安盛極衰始。

translations.literal: Zhangzong wished to polish culture, yet flawed government grew daily, exactions knew no limit, popular strength was drained, and the Mingchang and Cheng’an zenith marked where decline began.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzong sought cultural gloss, but bad policy piled up, levies knew no end, the people were bled dry, and the Mingchang–Cheng’an peak was where the fall started.

sentences.zh: 至於衛紹，紀綱大壞，亡征已見。

translations.literal: By the time of Weishao, the great framework was broken and signs of ruin were already plain.
translations.idiomatic: By Weishao’s day the state’s frame was shattered and ruin was plain to see.

sentences.zh: 宣宗南度，棄厥本根，外狃餘威，連兵宋、夏，內致困憊，自速土崩。

translations.literal: Xuanzong crossed south, abandoned his own roots, outwardly clung to leftover might, linked arms against Song and Xia, and inwardly wore himself out — hastening his own collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong moved south, left his roots, leaned on fading power abroad, fought Song and Xia together, and exhausted himself within — quickening the fall.

sentences.zh: 哀宗之世無足為者。

translations.literal: Aizong’s age had nothing worth recounting.
translations.idiomatic: Aizong’s reign had nothing worth telling.

sentences.zh: 皇元功德日盛，天人屬心，日出爝息，理勢必然。

translations.literal: Great Yuan’s merit grew daily; heaven and men turned their hearts — a torch out at sunrise, the trend was inevitable.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan’s merit rose day by day; heaven and men shifted — torchlight against the sun, the tide had to turn.

sentences.zh: 區區生聚，圖存於亡，力盡乃斃，可哀也矣。

translations.literal: A scant populace scheming to survive in extinction, strength spent before the end — pitiable indeed.
translations.idiomatic: A remnant people clinging to life in a dying state, spent to the last — how pitiful.

sentences.zh: 雖然，在《禮》「國君死社稷」，哀宗無愧焉。

translations.literal: Even so, in the Rites it is said, "When the state perishes, the ruler dies for the altars" — Aizong had no shame in that.
translations.idiomatic: Still, the Rites say, "When the state falls, the ruler dies for the altars" — on that count Aizong did not disgrace himself.
